headless_ctest: `scripts/build.ps1`: 20 of 20 CTest suites pass in 392.6 s, `fd_mpcc` taking 165.6 s.
desktop_ctest: `scripts/build.ps1 -Desktop`: 21 of 21 in 484.6 s, the QML controls suite with 482 checks and no QML warning; neither build reports a compiler warning.
recordings: With this build 288 of the 290 recordings in `out/runs` pass `--check-recording` (schemas 1 to 13, 33 of them schema 13). The two refused are `mpcc-dynamic-laps-mpcc`, cut off while it was written in the previous session and refused for its missing `events.csv`, and the exploratory `p62x-dynamic-1789837332`, written by this session before the dynamic car's schema 13 metadata was settled and refused for lacking `cg_height_m`.

method.plan_error: each recorded plan against where the recorded car went, a time ahead: prediction model and replanning together
method.model_error: each recorded plan against plant_response: the recorded plant driven from the decision's recorded state by the plan's planned commands, held over each control interval where they are at its end, under the configuration the plan was made with; nothing replanned
method.reported: every 0.25 s to 3 s: median, 95th percentile and worst distance between rear axles, median component along the plan's direction of travel, median size across it, median speed difference; the flying laps alone; the eight plans with the largest model error a second ahead
method.change: DynamicSingleTrack gains cg_height_m, drag_area_m2, downforce_area_m2 and aero_balance_front, off by default; reduced_single_track copies them from the four-wheel car

before_the_change.note: Exploratory runs with decision 0024's reduction, two laps under MPCC each, run beside each other, so their solve times are not reported. The dynamic car's run of this set was written before the dynamic car's schema 13 metadata was settled and is refused by the final loader; the dynamic car is unchanged by this decision, and its final run gives the same model error.
